feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: As Nepal identifies those killed in the floods, questions grow over China's reporting
entry.summary: One week after the deadly floods, very little is known about China's dead or missing. China's control over media and digital censorship is in stark contrast to open reporting in Nepal.

entry.title: 'Her body temperature was 106': How heat is killing Americans in their homes
entry.summary: Heat kills thousands of people across the U.S. every year. The risk is especially high for the millions of Americans who live in manufactured housing like mobile homes and trailers.

entry.title: The first day of school: Bells, bikes, buses and big feelings
entry.summary: Fifth graders calm school kindergartners in Los Angeles. Kids take the "bike bus" in Oklahoma. High school students take in a new high school building in Oregon.

entry.title: The copper peptide trend has gone from creams to injections — ahead of the science
entry.summary: The peptide is supposed to deliver flawless and firm skin, promote wound healing and other anti-aging effects. So what's the evidence behind GHK-Cu?

entry.title: Investigators seek answers after Amazon cargo plane crash kills five at Miami airport
entry.summary: An Amazon Prime cargo plane was landing at the airport around 2 p.m. ET on Sunday when it overran the runway, crashed and rammed into vehicles on the ground, according to FAA.

entry.title: Germany's far-right achieves an electoral breakthrough in key state election
entry.summary: Germany's populist, far-right Alternative for Germany party has declared victory in the state of Saxony-Anhalt after more than doubling its share of the vote in the first of several regional elections this fall.

entry.title: American Muslims are giving Texas barbecue a halal makeover
entry.summary: Even as anti-Muslim rhetoric rises in Texas, Muslim pitmasters are winning over diners and reshaping one of the state's most iconic culinary traditions.

entry.title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
entry.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.

entry.title: QUIZ: Ugh, I'll do it later. How much do you know about procrastination?
entry.summary: Learn a few surprising facts about procrastination — and helpful tools to overcome it — with this quiz. It's based on social scientist Itamar Shatz's new book, Solving Procrastination.

entry.title: Whatever happened to kindness? Spoiler alert: Our readers prove it's alive and well
entry.summary: We asked readers to share stories about a moment of kindness involving a stranger. Here are some of their heartwarming anecdotes.
